ottoextra.name: OttoExtra
ottoextra.set.tweaks.desc: Optional client-side effects and gameplay tweaks.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.toolprotect.desc: Cancels left/right-click interactions when the held tool is about to break, and warns once at low durability.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.toolprotect.blockAt: Interactions are cancelled when the tool has at most this many uses left.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.toolprotect.warnPer: One-time actionbar warning when durability drops below this percentage.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.desc: Red adrenaline edge and heartbeat at low health. Client-side only.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.blur.tip: Edges blur at low health while the center stays sharp. HUD stays sharp.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.blurHeart: Edge blur starts below this number of hearts (1 heart = 2 health).
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.blurStren: How strongly the edges blur (0 = off, 3 = strong).
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.fov.tip: Slight FOV increase at low health — adrenaline feel.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.fovMax.ti: Maximum FOV boost in degrees at full intensity.
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.startHeal: Effect begins below this health (server max 40 = 20 hearts, start 20 = 10 hearts).
ottoextra.set.tweaks.lowhealth.calm.tip: Heartbeat and heavy blur calm down after a few seconds without new damage.
ottoextra.resourcepack.status.current: Server resource pack is up to date
ottoextra.config.title: OttoExtra Settings
ottoextra.config.restart_hint: Module switches take effect after restart.
ottoextra.set.letter.sendMode.tip: PAGE: one /letter message per book page (\n-encoded, 1 page = 1 Discord announcement). LEGACY: one message per line (old behavior).
ottoextra.set.letter.pageModeDelay.tip: Delay between pages in PAGE mode (ms).
ottoextra.regions.screen.title: Fief Info
ottoextra.regions.lead.full: The %s is led by %s and counts %s residents.
ottoextra.set.map.politicalOpacity.tip: Opacity of the political areas during the day (0-100%).
Opacity at night — automatically lower because the map is darker (0-100%).
ottoextra.set.map.calibrationArrows.tip: Debug arrows to shift the painted map on the worldmap. Default: off.
ottoextra.set.map.paintedSimple.tip: Renders the painted map without the special shader. Enable if the map stays black (some modpacks). No day/night blending.
ottoextra.config.map.paintedFullCover: Full painted map when zoomed out
ottoextra.set.map.paintedFullCover.tip: Hides Xaero's terrain when zoomed out and shows the painted map everywhere at 100% — once only the top lieges' banners are shown. Only while the political map is active.
ottoextra.set.rpn.click.desc: Shift-left-click a name in chat or shift-right-click a player to open the people book at that person.
ottoextra.set.rpn.click.tip: Shift-left-click in chat / shift-right-click a player. Default: off.
ottoextra.set.rpn.meet.tip: Unknown RP speakers get a "!" above their head; shift-right-click opens the meet GUI. Default: off.
ottoextra.meet.title: Meet person
ottoextra.meet.question: Do you know this person?
ottoextra.set.chat.shiftTab.tip: Shift+Tab in chat cycles the channel (instead of vanilla player-name autocomplete). Default: on.
ottoextra.set.chat.longchat.desc: Type unlimited on one line; on send split automatically into several messages.
ottoextra.set.chat.longchat.tip: Split long input at word boundaries and send staggered so it reads as one big message. Default: on.
ottoextra.set.chat.longchatDelayMs.tip: Time between message parts in milliseconds (500–1500). Default: 800.
ottoextra.set.rpn.marker.desc: Appearance of the 3D exclamation mark above unknown RP speakers.
ottoextra.set.rpn.marker.glow.tip: Marker glows regardless of light. Default: on.
ottoextra.set.rpn.marker.height.tip: Extra height above the head in blocks. Default: 0.55.
ottoextra.set.rpn.marker.size.tip: Size factor of the marker. Default: 1.0.
ottoextra.set.rpn.marker.spin.tip: Spin speed around the Y axis. 0 = static. Default: 1.0.
ottoextra.set.rpn.ooc.tip: Also show RP names in the OOC channels Offtopic and Hilfe. Default: off.
ottoextra.rpnames.people.title: Known people
ottoextra.rpnames.people.select: Select a person on the left
ottoextra.rpnames.people.forgetAllHint: Click again to delete all (backup is created).
ottoextra.rpbook.title: RP People Book
ottoextra.rpbook.select: Select a person on the left
ottoextra.rpbook.conflict.head: ⚠ Conflict
ottoextra.rpbook.groups.hint: Label, colors, titles — saving writes title-groups.json
ottoextra.rpbook.import.known: People from API — update known only (recommended)
ottoextra.rpbook.import.ottoplusFailed: OttoPlus import failed — put ottotalk_players.json in: %s
ottoextra.rpbook.import.hintKnown: Known only: fills RP name/title for people you already have. Manual data stays untouched.
ottoextra.rpbook.import.hintAll: All: additionally creates every API player with RP data (~2500).
ottoextra.rpbook.import.spoiler: Warning: importing people can spoil RP knowledge. "Known only" is recommended.
ottoextra.rpbook.import.hintBackup: A backup is created automatically before every import and before "Forget all" (config/ottoextra/rpnames/backups).
ottoextra.rpbook.forgetAllHint: Click again to delete all (backup is created).
ottoextra.map.groupColors.title: Faction colors (political map)
ottoextra.following.title: Following
ottoextra.following.name: Name
ottoextra.rpbook.titles.name: Title
ottoextra.rpbook.titles.select: Select a title on the left
ottoextra.rpbook.titles.reset.tip: Reset color + variants to the category default.
ottoextra.rpbook.titles.newCategory.tip: Create a category with the current color value.
ottoextra.map.bannerEdit.title: Banner position
ottoextra.map.bannerEdit.hint: Drag the block with the mouse — release to save.
ottoextra.map.bannerEdit.noRegion: No region detected — enter a region to see the block.
ottoextra.letter.title: Letter & Announcement
ottoextra.letter.drafts.title: Letter drafts
ottoextra.letter.fmt.title: Formatting
ottoextra.letter.fmt.subtitle: Colors & style for the letter
ottoextra.set.letter.formatting.tip: Shows a formatting helper and colors the letter live. On send, §-codes are converted to safe &-codes automatically.
ottoextra.set.letter.formattingPaste.tip: Pasted &6/&l codes become §6/§l so they render live.
ottoextra.letter.mode.title: How should this text be sent?
ottoextra.letter.mode.hint: Letter = /letter to a player · Announcement = one Discord message per page
ottoextra.letter.prompt.intro: §a[Letter] §7The letter is written. What should happen with it?
ottoextra.letter.bookImport.title: Import book
ottoextra.letter.bookImport.found: %s page(s) found — importing replaces the draft.
ottoextra.letter.preflight.title: Check announcement
ottoextra.letter.recipient.title: Choose recipient
ottoextra.letter.recovery.title: Unfinished send found
ottoextra.letter.preflight.manualSubmitH: No submit command configured — run the announcement command manually afterwards.
ottoextra.letter.announcement.manualSubm: Text written via /letter. Now run the announcement command.
ottoextra.letter.page.tooLong: A page is too long for PAGE mode and was skipped. Please shorten it.
ottoextra.settings.title: OttoExtra — Settings
ottoextra.settings.overview.head: Modules — click to open settings
ottoextra.settings.backups.head: Backups
ottoextra.settings.backups.desc: Snapshots of all OttoExtra data (config, people book, letters). A fresh backup of the current state is created automatically before any restore.
ottoextra.settings.backup.missing: No backup! Please create one under Backups.
ottoextra.settings.escHint: Press Esc again to discard changes!
ottoextra.set.rp.desc: Keeps the Ottonien resource pack up to date automatically.
ottoextra.set.rp.card.desc: Check, download and enable the pack on startup.
ottoextra.set.rp.respect.tip: On: if you disable the pack manually it stays disabled. Off: the mod re-enables it.
ottoextra.set.rp.net.desc: Where the pack comes from and download timeouts.
ottoextra.set.chat.desc: Channel indicator in chat and convenience features.
ottoextra.set.chat.channel.desc: The active channel is shown left of the input; click to switch.
ottoextra.set.chat.autoSprechen.tip: Automatically sends /s when joining the server, making Speak the default channel.
ottoextra.set.chat.bang.desc: Flashing exclamation marks before [Offtopic] as a public-channel reminder.
ottoextra.set.regions.desc: Toast when entering fiefs and regions.
ottoextra.set.regions.toast.desc: Banner toast with crest, name and hierarchy.
ottoextra.set.regions.badgeLayout.desc: Region toast dimensions: widths, margin, icon, padding. Use the preview button to see it live.
ottoextra.set.regions.badgeText.desc: Font sizes in the toast (title, region, hierarchy, hint).
ottoextra.regions.themes.title: Toast themes
ottoextra.config.regions.show.title: "You enter" line
ottoextra.regions.themes.name: Name
ottoextra.set.tags.desc: Nametags above player heads: title, RP name, account.
ottoextra.set.tags.visibility.desc: REALISTIC shows tags only with line of sight — like real recognition.
ottoextra.set.tags.lines.desc: Which lines appear above the head.
ottoextra.set.tags.scale.desc: Font sizes per line (1.0 = vanilla) and line spacing.
ottoextra.set.map.desc: Painted map, fief borders and political overlay for Xaero.
ottoextra.set.map.visibility.desc: What is drawn on the large Xaero world map.
ottoextra.set.map.onlyOttonien.tip: On: overlays only on the Ottonien server. Off: everywhere (e.g. singleplayer tests).
ottoextra.set.map.minimap.desc: Borders, painted map and fills in the round/square minimap.
ottoextra.set.map.hud.desc: Crest, faction name and rank next to the minimap — position via drag&drop.
ottoextra.set.map.style.desc: Colors, lines and zoom thresholds of map elements.
ottoextra.set.map.hudAdv.desc: Width, scale and colors of the HUD texts.
ottoextra.set.rpn.desc: Local RP name system: chat, tablist and people book.
ottoextra.set.rpn.chat.desc: RP names in chat; unknowns as placeholder or account name.
ottoextra.set.rpn.colors.desc: Global color for player and RP names (blank = default). Overridable per title in the People Book.
ottoextra.set.rpn.playerNameColor.tip: Global color for player/account names (#RRGGBB, blank = default).
ottoextra.set.rpn.rpNameColor.tip: Global color for RP names (#RRGGBB, blank = default).
ottoextra.set.rpn.tablist.desc: RP names and titles in the player list.
ottoextra.set.rpn.tablistTitles.tip: Shows or hides titles in the player list. RP names and crests remain unaffected.
ottoextra.set.rpn.tablistTitlesAlways.ti: Regularly copies the current server title into the people book. Display can be disabled independently.
ottoextra.set.rpn.people.desc: Manage all known people, titles and colors.
ottoextra.set.letter.desc: Letter editor with parchment look, placeholders and announcements.
ottoextra.set.letter.editor.desc: Right-click with the trigger item opens the editor.
ottoextra.set.letter.triggerItem.tip: Item display name that opens the editor on right-click. Partial match is enough.
ottoextra.set.letter.commands.desc: Commands used to write and send letters.
ottoextra.set.letter.submitCommand.tip: Empty = the mod sends no submit command; you get a chat hint and run it yourself.
ottoextra.set.letter.layout.desc: Safe page limits for announcements and send delays (anti-spam).
ottoextra.set.map.bannerFaction.tip: Additional text line with the name of the faction holding the fief — its own drag&drop element.
ottoextra.set.map.liegeTop.tip: Off: direct liege. On: topmost liege of the vassal chain (e.g. Holdstewik instead of Mayenburg).
ottoextra.letter.fmt.clearHint: Removes colors and styles only from the selected text.
ottoextra.map.parchment.title: Ottonien Map
ottoextra.letter.preview.title: Letter preview
ottoextra.update.title: New OttoExtra version available
ottoextra.update.hint: Updating OttoExtra is recommended. The release page will open in your browser; the mod does not update itself automatically.

ottoextra.welcome.title: Welcome to OttoExtra!
ottoextra.welcome.intro: OttoExtra expands your experience on Ottonien with practical and immersive extras for more clarity, convenience and atmosphere.
ottoextra.welcome.features: Features include RP names and a people book, an expanded letter editor, map and region tools, plus improvements for chat and name tags.
